name: Gur-Sel Turizm Tasimacilik Ve Servis Ticaret A.S.
summary: Gür-Sel Turizm Tasimacilik ve Servis Ticaret A.S. provides transportation services in Turkey. It provides personnel transportation; student transportation; passenger car, minibus, bus rental services; urban public transport; and intercity transportation services. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
